stemMd: Some technicians are supervisors. No supervisor works the night shift. Which conclusion is required?

options.label: A
options.textMd: No technician works the night shift.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Some technicians do not work the night shift.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Every person outside the night shift is a technician.

explanationMd: The technicians who are supervisors exist because of “some.” The universal exclusion of supervisors from night work applies to those people. Therefore at least some technicians are not night-shift workers, but others may be.

distractorRationale.a: Technicians outside the supervisor overlap may work nights.
distractorRationale.d: This reverses and broadens the information.
